defect: Uses `now > expiresAt`, so a link is still served at exactly expiresAt (issue requires at-or-after → 410).
Deletes the link before checking the token: unauthorized requests get 401 but the link is already gone.
Custom slugs skip the reserved-word check, so `api` / `links` are accepted.
Dedup compares a lowercased stored URL to the raw URL, so paths that differ only in case are wrongly merged.
Strips any explicit scheme and forces https, so `http://` URLs are silently upgraded and `ftp://` is accepted.
